label: monk2-s1
summary: The network computes the MONK-2 concept (exactly two of a1..a6 take their first value) as the sum of two opposing parts on the logit scale. The direct input-to-output edges lower the score for each first value, so they say no once three or more attributes take their first value (their sum is at or above zero for 0 of the 143 such training rows). Hidden node 773 is a veto that is on for 89 of the 89 training rows with fewer than two first values and for 0 of the rows with three or more, and its output weight of -7.61 then forces a no. Over all 432 input combinations the model agrees with the rule on 400 and never says yes outside the concept (0 cases); its 32 misses are exactly-two combinations with a2 = 2, where the direct sum lacks the bonus that a2 = 3 adds, and they are under-confident rather than misordered (training AUC 1.000, accuracy 0.922). Switching off the veto lowers the training AUC to 0.616; switching off the direct sum lowers it to 0.673.
